identity.title: Restricted Live Orchestration + First-Live Canary Core
identity.objective: Implement the protected manual foreground successor that consumes one exact current ExploratoryGateCPermit, requires strict host/access/account/venue/risk revalidation, persists the exact fresh admission basis, permits at most one bounded BUY economic CREATE transmit, and reconciles partial fills, cancellation ambiguity, settlement and restart state under Karl's fixed USD 100 account, USD 5 order, USD 30 aggregate commitment and USD 70 free-collateral envelope; implementation/CI remains zero-real-product-activity and first real activation is separately gated.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Karl explicitly authorized Side16 to draft S10-LIVE-ORCH-01 after Side16's independent pre-draft audit and requested predictable implementation blockers be incorporated into a one-shot WP. Deterministic pre-freeze compatibility discovery requires exactly 27 paths: protected gateway/orchestrator/store/tests, the directly implicated EXEC-FEAS vocabulary/evaluator/contract repair, canonical package/status/docs and three mechanically implicated doc-truth guards. Authorization is for exactly this XL scope and does not authorize a 28th path, merge, real credentials, account access, orders, capital or live activation.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the exact 27-path S10-LIVE-ORCH-01 diff. The dormant LIVE-ORCH orchestrator and episode persistence, BUY-only admission/risk/recovery changes, EXEC-FEAS minimum-order semantic correction, contract/status/docs and tests disappear; merged exploratory-permit, historical WP175 Gate-B/Gate-C substrate and proven execution-host release remain. No real credential, account, venue, order, capital or live state exists from implementation/CI to roll back.

api_matrix.reason: The WP changes protected execution-gateway runtime, adds one foreground orchestrator, corrects one directly blocking public-feasibility semantic and otherwise consumes predecessor interfaces read-only.

semantic_fields.reason: Protected live admission depends on closed capital, identity, venue-drift, mutation, reconciliation and activation semantics.

items.required_rule: account capital basis 100; one BUY worst-case commitment 5; aggregate commitment 30; free collateral reserve 70; auto scaling false
items.validation_rule: all four constraints are checked independently before every CREATE and no runtime input may widen them
items.safe_output: closed pass/fail codes and bounded totals

items.required_rule: economic CREATE supports BUY only in the first canary; SELL permit rejects SIDE_UNSUPPORTED_FIRST_CANARY
items.validation_rule: rejection occurs before durable admission and before signing/transmit; exposure-reducing cancellation remains allowed

items.required_rule: observed realized-PnL loss 5, observed position-PnL drawdown 7.5 and observed cumulative canary loss 10; no UTC-day or high-water claim
items.validation_rule: document exact source fields; unknown required input blocks new exposure

items.required_rule: fresh snapshot/book metrics may change but exact market condition token BUY intent style type size price and structural eligibility must remain compatible
items.validation_rule: fresh snapshot and assessment IDs need not equal historical permit IDs; current assessment remains FEASIBLE or LIMITED and every runtime risk check passes
items.safe_output: fresh snapshot and assessment ids plus admission result

items.required_rule: durable admission binds permit intent fresh venue/assessment host currentness access wallet/account capital fee and observed-PnL evidence before CREATE_STARTED
items.validation_rule: admission persistence succeeds before CREATE_STARTED; persistence failure causes zero economic transmit
items.safe_output: sanitized admission evidence and bounded totals

items.required_rule: position entry commitment plus open BUY remainder plus nonterminal trade plus ambiguous CREATE plus unreflected fee; never mark-to-market-only
items.validation_rule: one episode principal partitions without double counting and ambiguous or unknown state is conservatively reserved
items.safe_output: total committed capital and closed provenance counts

items.required_rule: one permit may have one durable CREATE_STARTED and one economic post maximum; no automatic CREATE retry
items.validation_rule: CREATE_STARTED precedes transmit and any possibly transmitted unknown response becomes AMBIGUOUS

items.required_rule: passive known maker fee zero; aggressive known fee uses fresh conservative five-decimal upper bound; unknown fee blocks; actual fee is claimed only when attributable
items.validation_rule: principal plus fee reserve is at most 5 and ambiguous actual fee remains reserved
items.safe_output: fee reserve and attributable delta or FEE_RECONCILIATION_AMBIGUOUS

items.required_rule: MATCHED MINED RETRYING are nonterminal committed; CONFIRMED is terminal success; FAILED is terminal failure
items.validation_rule: nonterminal trade blocks new exposure and FAILED is never counted as an active fill
items.safe_output: trade id digests and closed status counts

items.required_rule: same cancel attempt identity never retries; authoritative still-live order may receive a new cancel attempt identity; at most three rounds per invocation
items.validation_rule: unconverged recovery becomes RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED and never authorizes CREATE
items.safe_output: cancel attempt identities and closed recovery state

items.required_rule: restart begins no-new-exposure; clean prior terminal episode allows a fresh permit; known residual positions remain committed; unknown state blocks
items.validation_rule: canonical store replay plus authoritative REST reconciliation converges before new admission

items.required_rule: Gamma minimum is USDC notional and CLOB minimum is shares with no equality requirement
items.validation_rule: notional and shares are independently compared and missing facts remain UNKNOWN

items.required_rule: merged dormant capability never activates real credentials account orders or capital; first real canary requires separate exact-merge Karl authorization
items.validation_rule: implementation and CI use zero real product network credentials account access orders and capital

items.required_rule: pinned polymarket-client 0.10.0 is authoritative; aggressive BUY construction is accepted only if post-construction inspection preserves the exact permit price share and principal caps; rounding-sensitive cases that cannot preserve authority fail ORDER_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED and do not authorize a dependency upgrade
items.validation_rule: offline regression includes at least one rounding-sensitive 0.10.0 BUY case; no encoded order may exceed the exact permit price requested shares principal or worst-case commitment
items.safe_output: ORDER_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED or sanitized verified order economics

items.required_rule: product runtime states remain ADMISSION_PENDING ADMITTED CREATE_STARTED CREATE_REJECTED CREATE_ACCEPTED CREATE_AMBIGUOUS RESTING CANCEL_STARTED RECONCILING SETTLEMENT_PENDING TERMINAL_NO_POSITION TERMINAL_KNOWN_POSITION RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED with the prompt-defined fail-closed transitions
items.validation_rule: clean terminal episodes may yield to a later fresh permit; known residual commitment persists; any unknown corrupt replay-mismatched or unresolved state blocks new exposure
